name: Mary of Bethany
title: The Worshiping Disciple
summary: Mary of Bethany was the sister of Martha and Lazarus. She is known for sitting at Jesus' feet and listening to his words, and for anointing his feet with expensive nard oil. Jesus defended her both against Martha and against critics, saying that what she had done would be told everywhere.

keyEvents.title: At Jesus' Feet
keyEvents.description: Mary chose to sit at Jesus' feet and listen rather than help with the serving.

keyEvents.title: At Lazarus' Death
keyEvents.description: Mary fell down before Jesus and wept, and Jesus was deeply moved.

keyEvents.title: The Anointing in Bethany
keyEvents.description: Mary anointed Jesus' feet with costly nard and wiped them with her hair.
